title: Direct image along a split cover is the product of the restrictions to the sheets
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and suppose $Y=\coprod_{j\in J}V_j$ for a finite set $J$ (possibly empty) and pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes $V_j$ covering $Y$ such that each $f|_{V_j}:V_j\to X$ is an isomorphism of schemes; let $s_j:X\to Y$ be the inverse of $f|_{V_j}$ followed by the inclusion $V_j\hookrightarrow Y$, an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], hence etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1). Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $H$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an etale morphism $e:T\to Y$ write $H|_e$ for the restriction of $H$ to $T_{\Et}$, $(H|_e)(V\to T)=H(V\to T\xrightarrow{e}Y)$ with the restriction maps of $H$, a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$. For an object $w:W\to X$ of $X_{\Et}$ let $\sigma_{j,W}=(\mathrm{id}_W,s_j\circ w):W\to W\times_XY$ [def-pc-fibre-product]; since $\mathrm{pr}_2\circ\sigma_{j,W}=s_j\circ w$, it is a morphism of $Y_{\Et}$ from $(W,s_j\circ w)$ to $(W\times_XY,\mathrm{pr}_2)$. Then the maps\n$$(f_*H)(W)=H(W\times_XY)\longrightarrow\prod_{j\in J}H(W\xrightarrow{s_j\circ w}Y)=\prod_{j\in J}(H|_{s_j})(W),\qquad t\mapsto\bigl(H(\sigma_{j,W})(t)\bigr)_{j\in J},$$\nwhere $f_*$ is the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], form an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules $f_*H\xrightarrow{\sim}\prod_{j\in J}H|_{s_j}$ onto the sectionwise product, which is the product in the category of sheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules (the zero sheaf if $J=\varnothing$). This is the step 'Thus the lemma says that ... $\prod_{i=1,\ldots,n}\mathcal F_i$' of the proof of Stacks Project Lemma 095B (etale-cohomology, lemma-pushforward-locally-constant); compare the reformulation in the split case (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-exists].

proof.text: For a fixed W in X.Etale, splitCoverSectionsLimit supplies the limiting fan in ModuleCat whose vertex is H(W times_X Y) and whose legs are the displayed restrictions H(sigma_j,W). This is precisely the geometric decomposition and gluing in the original steps 1 and 2; it makes no naturality or sheaf-product assertion.

Construct each sheaf morphism q_j: f_*H -> H|s_j with component H(sigma_j,W). To prove naturality, rewrite the two composites by functoriality of H, remove opposites, and use extensionality of morphisms over Y and the two pullback projections. The resulting equations follow from the pullback lift and map formulas. Linearity is built into these maps in ModuleCat. Restriction is already a sheaf by the definition localizationRestriction.

Form c = Fan.mk (f_*H) q. The forgetful functor sheafToPresheaf reflects limits. Apply evaluationJointlyReflectsLimits, and identify each evaluated fan with the limiting fan of the first step using Fan.isLimitMapConeEquiv twice. Thus c is a limiting fan of sheaves. Fan.nonempty_isLimit_iff_isIso_piLift makes Pi.lift q invertible. Use asIso of this morphism; Pi.lift_pi proves the prescribed component formula. This includes the empty family. These are the generic Mathlib reflection and fan declarations themselves, for ModuleCat-valued sheaves; the Type-valued statement of lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-limits-sectionwise is not invoked.

lean.statement: theorem directImage_splitCover_product {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {J : Type w} [Finite J] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] (f : Y ⟶ X) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y) (t : ∀ j, X ⟶ V j) (hcolim : IsColimit (Cofan.mk Y i)) (hinv₁ : ∀ j, t j ≫ i j ≫ f = 𝟙 X) (hinv₂ : ∀ j, i j ≫ f ≫ t j = 𝟙 (V j)) (hopens : ∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion (i j)) (hclosed : ∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion (i j)) (H : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) : letI : ∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (i j) := hopens letI : ∀ j, IsIso (t j) := fun j ↦ ⟨⟨i j ≫ f, hinv₁ j, hinv₂ j⟩⟩ let s := fun j ↦ t j ≫ i j let R := fun j ↦ (Etale.localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (s j) inferInstance).obj H ∃ e : (Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj H ≅ ∏ᶜ R, ∀ (j : J) (W : X.Etale), ((e.hom ≫ Pi.π R j).hom.app (op W)) = H.obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (A := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale (s j))).obj W) (B := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W) (pullback.lift (𝟙 W.left) (W.hom ≫ s j) (by change (𝟙 W.left) ≫ W.hom = (W.hom ≫ s j) ≫ f simp [s, Category.assoc, hinv₁ j])) (by simp)).op

reviewed_lean.note: f:Y->X; finite possibly empty J (Type w, Finite); V_j clopen covering disjoint = IsColimit Cofan + IsOpenImmersion + IsClosedImmersion; f|V_j iso with inverse t j (hinv1/hinv2), s_j = t j ≫ i j; Λ comm ring, H ModuleCat-valued sheaf on Y_et; f_* = Etale.lowerStar; H|_{s_j} = Etale.localizationRestriction (literal precomposition with Over.map, no sheafification); σ_{j,W} = pullback.lift (𝟙 W) (w ≫ s_j) as Over.homMk; ∃ iso to ∏ᶜ with every component = H(σ_{j,W}); no statement change
